answer: Require every agent to lock a stake that works like quartz under pressure: hard to fake, easy to verify. A new identity must bond tokens for a full epoch, and if two identities share one operator walnut-sized hardware fingerprint or funding trail, both bonds burn. Spawning a thousand sock puppets then costs more than any reward, while a single honest agent pays only a small ember of yield. Sybil resistance priced in, not policed by hand.
